name: infantry

source.title: Future - Generic Space Infantry Troops
source.author: Guy_montag
source.notes: Infantry rework (LANCE-19, 2026-10-31): a SimVehicle with a skinned-style skeleton (joint_* with Walk and Run). The approved v1 fit (`infantry_veh.json`: scale 1.85, yaw 275, base cut, nudge, parts_box with the legs split along the stride axis) was captured by `v3_rigid.py` and run through the mech path as a rigid unit: one rigid part per original node (Inf_Body, Inf_Lleg/Rleg, Inf_Lfoot/Rfoot, joint_Head, joint_Arms), no actuators. The limbs are plain rigid parts, so hips and shoulders open slightly in the walk. Team colour (style guide §9, Lee 2026-10-31): only the helmet, the shoulder pads (Inf_Body above z 1380 mm) and a chest band (z 1170-1260 mm) take team colour; everything else is a fixed dark armour grey (`fixed_colour` with `except`).
